themes.title: No way to save or persist a recurring filtered view
themes.summary: The participant rebuilds the same weekly filter set from scratch every Monday because there's no saved-view/preset feature, and filters silently reset when navigating tabs.
supporting_quotes: I have to rebuild the filters from scratch every single time
the filters reset mid-way if I navigate to a different tab

themes.title: No lightweight way to share a specific view with teammates
themes.summary: Bookmarking doesn't preserve filter state and there's no shareable link, so the participant resorts to screenshotting the dashboard.
supporting_quotes: the filter state isn't actually encoded in the URL
I usually just screenshot it and Slack it over

pain_points.description: No saved filter presets — the same weekly filter combination must be rebuilt manually every time, taking ~20 minutes.
pain_points.quote: I have to rebuild the filters from scratch every single time because the dashboard doesn't save filter presets.

pain_points.description: Filters reset unexpectedly when navigating away from the current tab, forcing a full restart, which has happened 5-6 times in two months.
pain_points.quote: the filters reset mid-way if I navigate to a different tab

pain_points.description: Filter state is not encoded in the URL, so bookmarking or sharing a link doesn't preserve the view.
pain_points.quote: the filter state isn't actually encoded in the URL, so the bookmark just opens the dashboard with default filters

action_items.action: Add saved filter presets (e.g. named views like "My Monday Report") that can be loaded in one click.
action_items.rationale: Single highest-impact fix per the participant; recurring weekly pain.

action_items.action: Persist filter state across tab navigation within a session.
action_items.rationale: Currently causes users to lose and rebuild work mid-task.

action_items.action: Encode filter state in the URL and add a native shareable-link option for filtered views.
action_items.rationale: Would replace the current screenshot-and-Slack workaround for sharing reports with teammates.
